_about: Jobs stalkers give (sim/zone_jobs.cpp). givers: 'trader' or faction keys (drifter bandit army bastion opensky merc choir institute). {place} {mutants} {need} {family} {trophy} {faction} {giver} are filled in from the world. money: [min, max]; items: one of them is added; rep: standing with the giver's faction.

jobs.title: Thin out the {mutants}
jobs.text: A pack of {mutants} is holed up near {place}. They've had two of ours on the road this week. Kill {need} of them.

jobs.title: Clear out the {faction}
jobs.text: {faction} have dug in near {place} and the road there is closed to us. Put {need} of them down and come back.

jobs.title: A {family} artifact
jobs.text: I have a buyer for anything born in a {family} anomaly. Bring me one, any kind, and you'll get more than the market pays.

jobs.title: {need} x {trophy}
jobs.text: Bring me {need} {trophy}. The scientists pay for them and I take my cut. Don't ask what they do with them.

jobs.title: A dead man's stash
jobs.text: A stalker who owed me money hid his stash near {place} before the Zone took him. It's marked on your PDA. Find it, keep what's in it, and tell me it's real.
